note: Recast from entry 94 of Roonwal & Chhotani (1997), the original in English. The pleural processes on the sides of the meso- and metathorax occur in the worker, nymph and larva; the authors confirmed them after examining the syntype material at the Forest Research Institute (F.R.I.), India, and note that no other species has this structure; the morphological details of the nymph and larva (quoting the description of Holmgren & Holmgren 1917) are not recorded here. The original gives the alate pronotum length as 0.70–0.80 mm and notes that the 1.05 mm recorded by Holmgren & Holmgren (1917) is an error. The diagnostic characters follow the keys to the alates and soldiers in that work (p. 571–572). The synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, type records, distribution and biology have been omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head length to the mandibular bases 2.35–2.66, width 1.65–1.73 mm; mandibles thick throughout and relatively long for the head (mandible length/head length about 0.72); anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly angled, with a prominent median notch; pronotum width/head width about 0.95 and length/width 0.66; in bengalensis the mandibles are narrower, less curved forward and relatively shorter (that ratio 0.65–0.69), pronotum width/head width 0.81–0.88 and length/width 0.55–0.58. Alate antenna 18–19 segments, head length to the mandibular bases 1.18–1.24, width 1.45–1.55 mm, no occipital suture, forewing length 9.95–10.80 mm; dunensis has antenna 16–17 segments, a smaller head (length 1.00–1.13, width 1.25–1.30 mm) and forewing length 8.0–9.10 mm. The worker, nymph and larva have pleural processes on the sides of the meso- and metathorax, absent in all other species.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head pale to dark brown, the rest paler. Head and body moderately hairy, the hairs long and short. Body length with wings 12.0–13.50 mm, without wings 7.0–7.6 mm. Head nearly circular; length to the mandibular bases 1.18–1.24, width 1.45–1.55 mm. No occipital suture. Fontanelle minute. Eyes well developed, circular, black, major diameter 0.40–0.43 mm. Ocelli white, oval, about half their major diameter from the eye, major diameter 0.16–0.20 mm. Labrum dome-shaped, with a few hairs. Postclypeus slightly longer than the anteclypeus, inflated, with a median longitudinal suture. Mandibles of the typical Stylotermes type. Antenna 18–19 segments; segment 2 longer than segment 3 and about equal to segment 4. Pronotum flat, trapezoidal, the corners rounded, narrowing backwards; narrower than the head, wider than long (length 0.70–0.80, width 1.18–1.29 mm); anterior and posterior margins each with a weak median notch. Femora and tibiae long and slender; apical tibial spurs 3:2:2; tarsi 3-segmented. Wings hyaline, with a network formed by many fine cross-veins. Forewing length 9.95–10.80 mm; wing scale larger than that of the hindwing; costa thick; radial sector thick, parallel to the costa; media arising inside the wing scale, fine, unbranched; cubitus also arising inside the wing scale, with 21–22 branches. Hindwing length 9.50–10.40 mm; wing scale small; costa and radial sector as in the forewing; media arising from the radial sector outside the wing scale, sometimes with 1–2 branches; cubitus with 20–21 branches. Abdominal cerci short, 2-segmented; abdominal styli absent.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brownish yellow, the rest paler. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length including the mandibles about 8.0–8.80 mm. Head slightly elongate, nearly rectangular; length to the mandibular bases 2.35–2.66, maximum width 1.65–1.73 mm. Fontanelle minute, circular, situated in the anterior 1/3 of the head, with a small fontanelle gland; distance from the occiput to the fontanelle 1.70 mm. Labrum wide, lingulate, slightly wider than long (length 0.40, width 0.45 mm), the tip with several long hairs. Anteclypeus narrow; postclypeus longer, indistinctly delimited from the frons. Mandibles long, thick throughout (length 1.80 mm), slightly narrowing towards the tip, the tip sharp and slightly incurved; about 3/4 of the head length (mandible length/head length 0.72); inner margin with a small tooth in the posterior 1/3 and a larger tooth near the base. Antenna 14–15 segments; segment 2 short, segment 3 longer than segments 2 and 4. Postmentum long, rod-like, wide anteriorly; waist long, situated at the middle, the sides nearly parallel; length 2.00, maximum width 0.65, waist width 0.25 mm. Pronotum flat, trapezoidal (length 0.85–1.00, width 1.43–1.50 mm), wider than long; anterior margin distinctly angled with a prominent median notch, posterior margin with a weak median notch. Abdomen hairy. Cerci small, about 0.15 mm long, 2-segmented; abdominal styli absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pale yellow; pilosity moderate, the hairs on the abdominal tergites arranged in two irregular transverse rows. Body length 4.6–6.0 mm. Head nearly circular; length to the mandibular bases 0.95–1.25, width 1.15–1.35 mm. Fontanelle minute. Eyes small, degenerate; ocelli absent. Labrum, clypeus and mandibles as in the alate. Antenna 15–16 segments; segment 2 longer than segment 3. Pronotum flat, narrower than the head, trapezoidal, the corners rounded; length 0.43–0.65, width 0.85–1.13 mm. Mesonotum with a short pleural process on each side; metanotum with a long pleural process on each side. Legs long and slender; apical tibial spurs 3:2:2; tarsi 3-segmented. Cerci short; abdominal styli absent.
